description: Build-time, sandbox-only. Turns an allow/block description into a valid MailPolicy and writes mailbuttons.policy.json. Default-bounce (closed by default), capped at internal send, with a prompt-injection content guard. Never invents senders and never generates external-send capability — going external is a human promotion.

allow.description: Senders the agent should accept mail from. Each entry is matched by address OR domain. Only list senders the user actually named — never invent any.

address.description: Exact sender address to allow, e.g. alerts@stripe.com.

domain.description: Sender domain to allow, e.g. stripe.com. Use this OR address.

requireDkim.description: Require a passing DKIM signature for this sender.

requireSpf.description: Require a passing SPF check for this sender.

block.description: Senders to explicitly reject. With defaultAction 'bounce' anything not allowlisted is already rejected, so these are usually redundant; they are surfaced as warnings rather than silently expanding the policy.

address.description: Exact sender address to allow, e.g. alerts@stripe.com.

domain.description: Sender domain to allow, e.g. stripe.com. Use this OR address.

requireDkim.description: Require a passing DKIM signature for this sender.

requireSpf.description: Require a passing SPF check for this sender.

contentGuards.description: Extra body-regex guards to add on top of the default prompt-injection guard.

outPath.description: Where to write the policy. Defaults to ./mailbuttons.policy.json.

sendScope.description: How far the agent may send. 'internal_only' grants send_internal to allowed senders; 'none' grants no send capability. External send is NEVER generated — it requires a human promotion.

name: mailbuttons_generate_policy

path.description: Absolute path the policy file was written to.

policy.description: The generated MailPolicy, exactly as written to disk.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes (e.g. redundant block entries, empty allowlist).

title: Generate a mailbuttons.policy.json
